indigo-pulse.$description: Indigo Pulse — Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

slate.$description: Slate — Hairline borders, dividers, secondary text, list separators — the structural gray that quietly defines the page grid

graphite.$description: Graphite — Navigation text, heading text, dark UI elements — the primary readable dark on white

ink.$description: Ink — Headline color, strongest body emphasis, near-black for maximum contrast on light surfaces

paper.$description: Paper — Page background, card surfaces, text on dark/indigo fills — the dominant canvas

mist.$description: Mist — Elevated panels, subtle background washes, light borders — the cool-tinted off-white that lifts content above the page

cloud.$description: Cloud — Secondary card surfaces, quiet content panels

mint-whisper.$description: Mint Whisper — Task category tag accent (product UI), logo green dot — pastel annotation, not interface chrome

lavender-drift.$description: Lavender Drift — Task category tag accent (product UI), logo blue dot — pastel annotation

avenir-next.$description: Sole typeface across the entire system — nav, body, headings, display. Avenir Next's geometric humanism gives the page a calm, friendly, Apple-adjacent feel. Weight 400 carries everything; weight 600 is reserved for navigation and small emphases. Display headlines at 65px with negative tracking create a compressed, confident presence rather than shouting.
